title: jev_factcheck claims.json
description: What an LLM writes and jev_factcheck reads. Everything is untrusted text; jev_factcheck validates and size-bounds it (see schema.py).

text.description: The answer text the claims come from. The report shows it with each claim underlined.

id.description: Unique per file. Default c1, c2, ... by position. Keep ids stable across correction rounds.

claim.description: One factual sentence, copied exactly from `text` so it can be marked there.

url.description: http(s) page that was opened. One source per claim.

quote.description: Copied VERBATIM from that page. Use ... or [...] between separate pieces. Never a paraphrase.

topic.description: general, health, science, law, news, ... (selects your source list, if any).

span.description: Optional [start, end) character offsets of the claim inside `text`. Spans must not overlap. If absent, the claim is marked where its exact text occurs in `text`.
